name: Macaw's Trapdoors / MoreCulling Compatibility
description: Prevents the exact Macaw ranch and bark trapdoors from culling neighboring solid faces through their intended openings.

exceptions.reason: The literal 23-block patch set is audited against Macaw's Trapdoors 1.1.5 and must fail closed if that provider registry changes.
regression_evidence: Audited mcw-trapdoors-1.1.5-mc26.2fabric.jar SHA-256 6411cb0ff6c6cc4312deed48c3ca69cdbcbae72e80ff4ed0269f2d0a78acd32d registers the exact ranch and bark identifiers patched by this release.

exceptions.reason: The compatibility calls the MoreBlockCulling per-block culling API verified in MoreCulling 1.8.1 and must not assume an unvalidated future contract.
regression_evidence: The dedicated 26.2 profile uses moreculling-fabric-26.2-1.8.1.jar SHA-256 ea04505496e4d35a8c94199884b6fafa69057efe50f2096d2988c11163d49122 while upstream issue #438 remains open for Macaw trapdoors.
